blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes mein C-X bond polar hai, kyun ke carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity (electrons ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat) mein farq hai. C-X ka carbon electrophilic markaz (electrons ka bhooka hissa) ban jata hai, jis par nucleophile (electron pair dene wala) hamla kar sakta hai. Doosri soorat yeh hai ke saath wale carbon ke hydrogen par base hamla kare. In do soorton se halogenoalkanes ke do qism ke reactions bante hain:
a) Woh reactions jin mein halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aa jata hai (nucleophilic substitution, ya SN reactions).

blocks.alt: Nu- se delta+ carbon ki taraf mura teer (curly arrow), aur C-X bond se X ki taraf mura teer. Teer ke baad Nu-C (baqi teen bonds ab doosri taraf) + X-. Labels: hamla karne wala nucleophile (Attacking Nucleophile), substrate molecule, substituted product, leaving group.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic substitution reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: b) Woh reactions jin mein halogenoalkane se HX nikal jata hai (elimination, ya E reactions), aur alkene banti hai.

blocks.alt: Substrate ke do jure carbons, aik par H aur agle par X (dono dashed dabbe mein), se alkene C=C + HX. Labels: Substrate Molecule, Alkene, Hydrogen Halide.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction (kitab ke PDF safha 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Substitution mein ek cheez nikalti hai aur doosri us ki jagah le leti hai (X gaya, Nu aaya). Elimination mein do cheezein (H aur X) nikalti hain aur un ki jagah do carbons ke darmiyan double bond ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki do qismein kaun si hain, aur har ek mein kaun hamla karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Nucleophilic substitution, jis mein nucleophile δ+ carbon par hamla karta hai; aur elimination, jis mein base saath wale carbon ke hydrogen par hamla karta hai.

items: Polar C-X: δ+ carbon electrophilic hai.
Do qism ke reactions: nucleophilic substitution (SN) aur elimination (E).
